This vignette describes the generation of first, the exploitable biomass, and second the associated abundance indices form the output of a SS3 model fit. 

```{r}
# WPTT 2020
run <- "io_h90_q0_tlambda1"
```

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)

run_path <- basename(tempfile(pattern = "ss3-"))
dir.create(run_path, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = run_path)

options(max.print = 10000)
```

```{r libraries}
library(skj)
library(r4ss)
library(plyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
FSCALAR <- 3

# copy files from package
copy_ss3_files(run = run, path = ".")

setwd(run)

# read SS files
skj_forecast <- SS_readforecast("forecast.ss", verbose = FALSE)
skj_dat      <- SS_readdat("data.ss", verbose = FALSE)
skj_starter  <- SS_readstarter("starter.ss", verbose = FALSE)

# use annual F-scalar
skj_forecast$Forecast <- 5
skj_forecast$F_scalar <- FSCALAR
skj_forecast$Nforecastyrs <- 20
skj_forecast$ForeCatch <- NULL

SS_writeforecast(skj_forecast, dir = ".", overwrite = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)

run_ss3()
```


```{r}
skj_out <- SS_output(dir = run, covar = FALSE, printstats = FALSE, verbose = FALSE)

# get exploitable biomass
# from numbers*weight*sel
skj_bex <- get_Bex(skj_dat, skj_out)
colnames(skj_bex)[ncol(skj_bex)] <- "Vuln"

index_fleets <- read_fleetinfo(skj_dat) %>% filter(type == "index") %>% select(fleetname)
index_units  <- read_fleetinfo(skj_dat) %>% filter(type == "index") %>% select(Fleet = fleetname, units)

skj_bex <- skj_bex %>% filter(Fleet %in% index_fleets[,1])
skj_bex <- ddply(skj_bex, .(Area, Fleet, Seas, Yr), summarise, Vuln = sum(Vuln)) # which Morph?

# create year:season
skj_bex <- skj_bex %>% mutate(Yr_Seas = Yr + (Seas - 1) / 4 + 0.125) %>% as.data.frame()

# merge
skj_vuln <- merge(skj_bex, index_units)

skj_vuln$Fleet_label <- with(skj_vuln, paste0(Fleet, " (", units, ")"))

# get from model report file
skj_vuln_out <- skj_out$cpue
colnames(skj_vuln_out)[9] <- "Vuln"

skj_vuln_out <- skj_vuln_out %>% filter(Fleet_name %in% index_fleets[,1])
skj_vuln_out <- skj_vuln_out %>% select(-Fleet)
colnames(skj_vuln_out)[1] <- "Fleet"

# safe removal of Subseas and Month
skj_vuln_out <- ddply(skj_vuln_out, .(Area, Fleet, Seas, Yr), summarise, Vuln = unique(Vuln), Obs = unique(Obs), Exp = unique(Exp))

# create year:season
skj_vuln_out <- skj_vuln_out %>% mutate(Yr_Seas = Yr + (Seas - 1) / 4 + 0.125) 

skj_vuln_out <- merge(skj_vuln_out, index_units)
skj_vuln_out$Fleet_label <- with(skj_vuln_out, paste0(Fleet, " (", units, ")"))
```

## VULNERABLE BIOMASS
```{r, echo = FALSE, fig.width = 10, height = 14}

gg <- ggplot() + 
  geom_line(data = skj_vuln_out, aes(Yr_Seas, Vuln / 1e3), col = "red", size = 3) + 
  geom_line(data = skj_vuln, aes(Yr_Seas, Vuln / 1e3)) + 
  facet_grid(Fleet ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = skj_out$endyr + 1, col = "blue") +
  labs(y = "Vulnerable Biomass", x = "Year (Season)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16)
print(gg)
```

## MODEL FIT AND PREDICTED INDICES
```{r, echo = FALSE, fig.width = 10, height = 14}
# FULL JOIN
skj_vuln_full <- left_join(skj_vuln, skj_vuln_out, by = c("Fleet", "Area", "Seas", "Yr", "Yr_Seas", "units", "Fleet_label"), suffix = c("", "_out"))

Q <- skj_out$cpue %>% group_by(Fleet) %>% summarise(Fleet_name = unique(Fleet_name), Q = unique(Calc_Q))
Q <- Q %>% select(-Fleet) %>% rename(Fleet = Fleet_name)

dfr <- left_join(skj_vuln_full, Q, by = "Fleet")

# PLOT MODEL FIT
gg <- ggplot(dfr) +
  geom_point(aes(Yr_Seas, Obs)) +
  geom_point(aes(Yr_Seas, Exp), col = "red", size = 3) +
  geom_line(aes(Yr_Seas, Vuln * Q)) +
  facet_grid(Fleet ~ ., scales = "free_y")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = skj_out$endyr + 1, col = "blue") +
  labs(y = "CPUE", x = "Year (Season)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16)
print(gg)
```
```{r, echo = FALSE, results = 'hide'}
unlink(run_path, recursive = TRUE)
```

Check package function `get_index()`
```{r}
dff <- get_index(skj_dat, skj_out)
ttt <- full_join(dff, dfr)
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, fig.width = 10, height = 14}
gg <- ggplot(ttt) +
  geom_point(aes(Yr_Seas, Exp), col = "red", size = 3) +
  geom_line(aes(Yr_Seas, Vuln * Q)) +
  geom_line(aes(Yr_Seas, index), col = "blue") +
  facet_grid(Fleet ~ ., scales = "free_y")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = skj_out$endyr + 1, col = "blue") +
  labs(y = "CPUE", x = "Year (Season)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16)
print(gg)
```
